rationale: No optimization is safely supported for this workflow given the repository state. The ci_history reports no completed runs and no measured baseline, so the precondition for history-derived or custom job timeouts (representative successful-duration history) is not met; the only measured P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT experiment was on a lightweight lint/typecheck job (~30 s median), whereas this workflow contains heavy Espressif container firmware builds that could exceed any guessed limit, tripping the contraindication that valid slow runs must not exceed the proposed timeout. required_checks are unverified (empty, status not_verified), so enabling matrix fail-fast (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST) or canceling superseded runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) could cancel required checks and alter required-status semantics. The build and host-tests matrices already set fail-fast: false, and all matrix targets appear to be distinct required build/test coverage that must be preserved. Applying a blanket timeout or cancellation change would risk breaking valid runs or hiding required results without representative data, so coverage is preserved by making no change.
